desc:
Serve waybills and hear the rolling thunder out on the high iron!

High Iron is a realistic North American train simulator that encourages you to play your own way! Choose from our unique selection of locomotives and rolling stock to assemble your own train and ride the rails! Cruise down the mainline, stop at stations, switch cars at industries, and more!

This game is in early development and is paid access as a result, but will be free-to-play down the line! You may experience bugs or find incomplete features during this stage of production. In its current form, High Iron is a free-roam sandbox game, but will later feature a currency system and objectives that can be completed to earn rewards and collect new trains! Developing such features takes time, and we do not have a consistent update schedule, so please be patient while waiting for new content.

To be informed about future updates, join the Nebula Games group!
